title: Payroll over a mixed list
prompt:
Complete `Employee` (fields name, base; `pay()` returns base) and `Manager extends Employee` (extra field bonus; `pay()` returns base **plus** bonus, using `super.pay()`). Then implement `payroll(ArrayList<Employee>)` summing every employee's `pay()`.

The list mixes both types; dispatch must do the work.

tests.name: mixed payroll
tests.hint: Manager.pay() = super.pay() + bonus; payroll loops once and lets dispatch choose.
